Case reference: 2014006567.CaseDesc: Benjamin Palluq was last seen on March 15, 2014 and was reported missing to police on March 21, 2014 from Iqaluit, Nunavut. Extensive search efforts and an investigation have been conducted but to date, these efforts have been inconclusive. Benjamin had no fixed address at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2025014496.CaseDesc: Derrick Ryde was last seen on February 28, 2025, while living on his uncle's property in Salmon Arm, British Columbia. Derrick is an experienced outdoorsman who frequently goes camping off-grid for periods of one to two weeks. Derrick has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006023799.CaseDesc: On July 12, 1999, Jerzy Ryglewicz was last seen at a gas station in Merrickville, Ontario. He has not been seen or made contact with any friends or family since.

Case reference: 2012020096.CaseDesc: On September 17, 2008, Kevin Michel was with two other people at Usinne Lake, near Creighton, Saskatchewan, harvesting rice. Witnesses state Kevin walked away from their camp for reasons unknown. Extensive ground, air and water searches were conducted in the area but failed to locate Kevin.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, "Kevin heart bombers" (text) or "Kevin (heart symbol) bombers"

Case reference: 2014003781.CaseDesc: William Leslie has not been seen or heard from by anyone, including his family, since September, 1993. His belongings were found in a remote area. He had been staying in a tent in the bush Southeast of Beaverlodge in Alberta. It appeared the tent was pitched in the fall of 1993. William's belongings were located under 2-3 feet of snow, along with his truck and bicycle. A jean jacket and leather jacket were located in the truck.

Hair: Brown, Shoulder, Short on top and long in back
Tattoo: Left Arm, Text "live your own life" in a ribbon
Right Arm, Text "born to be bad" and "Mom Dad"

Case reference: 2014005278.CaseDesc: On July 14, 2009, Yashpal Mehay left his residence in Surrey BC, and was scheduled to travel to Clinton BC, where he co-owned and operated a Petro Canada Gas Station with family. Yashpal was last seen at the Costco in Abbotsford BC, at 1450 hours on July 14, 2009, where he purchased tobacco, food and gas. Yashpal failed to arrive at his destination in Clinton BC, and there has been no communication with the family. He was very familiar with this route as he travelled it every other week. The Surrey RCMP has conducted extensive searches along the travelled route with negative results.

Shirt: Green, White, Long sleeve "American Eagle" polo

Case reference: 2014006301.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2013, at 4:30 P.M., Alexis St-Denis was at his residence in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Alexis sent a text to several people saying “I'm so sorry”. Later on, a passerby found a cell phone, wallet, and headphones belonging to Alexis on the Pont de Fer bridge on the river Saint-Maurice near Highway 40 in Quebec. Alexis has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004404.CaseDesc: On September 12, 1993, Sidiki Camara was reported missing by air traffic control after disappearing from the radar while flying to Prince Edward Island from the Moncton Airport. Sidiki's plane was last recorded descending at a high rate of speed. Only a few parts of the plane were found during a search of the crash location.

Case reference: 2014003988.CaseDesc: On February 16, 1989, Gordon Clark was last seen at his residence in Richmond, British Columbia.  He had an argument with his common law wife who left the residence and when she returned home, he was gone.  Gordon has not been heard from or seen by any family members or friends since.

Case reference: 2014002850.CaseDesc: On May 21, 1997, Ardavan TAHERZADEH last communicated with his parents while he was backpacking in India, indicating that he wished to explore more of the country. Ardavan was a University of British Columbia student who took a year off to teach English as a second language in Korea and travel extensively in Northern India.  His last call was from Koshla, Kullu Province in India. On June 28, 1997, Ardavan was reported missing to the West Vancouver Police Department by family after he missed his flight home on June 25, 1997. We have not received any communication from Ardavan since.

Case reference: 2014001849.CaseDesc: On August 14, 1974, Murphy Williams was last seen working in a labour camp located between Fort St. John and Dawson Creek in British Columbia. It was reported that Mr. Williams was exhibiting signs of distress and it is believed that he may have attempted to walk from the labour camp to Fort St. John.

Case reference: 2005004599.CaseDesc: On August 22, 1996, an unidentified man, believed to be Caucasian was recovered from the Sir Adam Beck Dam in the Niagara River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 145 lbs and his length was measured at 5'10" to 5’11”, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. He has evidence of heart disease and may have had heart problems in the past. It is estimated that he had been in the water for a few days up to two weeks prior to discovery. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts that this unidentified male is of European ancestry.

Hair: Brown, Grey, Long, Long grey and white beard 12cm
Teeth: No upper teeth and no lower posterior teeth; remaining teeth have roots only; crowns are lost due to decay.

Case reference: 2024055204.CaseDesc: Rico Akpaleapik was reported missing in Pond Inlet, Nunavut, on October 4, 2024.  Search and Rescue efforts were conducted by Nunavut Emergency Management, but were unable to locate him. A police investigation confirmed that Rico was last seen on September 27, 2024, walking alone on a road outside of town.

Case reference: 2012020011.CaseDesc: Daniel Richard McCallum was living in the Lillooet, BC area up until October 2008.  When his family hadn't heard from him for some time, they reported him missing. There are unconfirmed reports that he may have moved away, but police have been unable to determine his whereabouts. His disappearance is considered suspicious.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, scorpio sign with "Dan" written inside

Case reference: 2012020069.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1982, a resident of Gimli reported that Debbie Richardson first came to Gimli, Manitoba in 1972 to visit her brother. According to this report, she stayed with him for approximately three months and then went missing. Debbie's brother last saw her in September 1972 when he dropped her off on the highway to hitchhike to Winnipeg.  She has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2022009358.CaseDesc: On March 17, 2005, shortly after midnight, Patricia Bessel was last seen leaving her residence in Grand Island, New York. Patricia’s vehicle was subsequently located in a parking lot near the American Falls in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of her disappearance, Patricia was despondent

Case reference: 2014004759.CaseDesc: On March 21st 2006, Tayven Bear was playing with two other children on the ice of the Churchill River in Sandy Bay, Saskatchewan. Tayven fell into the river and he was never recovered.

Case reference: 2014001428.CaseDesc: On May 19, 1998, at approximately 7:00 p.m., Rémi Engrand left a residence for men in Valleyfield, Quebec, for a walk with two other residents of the center where he had been staying for a few days. They went to the Delpha-Sauvé Park, where Rémi wanted to go swimming in the river, near the waterfall. The three separated, leaving Rémi alone and when they returned, they found Rémi’s clothes on the shoreline. The current in this section of the river is very fast and the presence of the falls makes swimming very risky. Rémi has not been seen since this time.

Case reference: 2020036483.CaseDesc: Dorothy Cox was seen for the last time between the months of December 1942 and April 1943 in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004725.CaseDesc: Jack Ford was last seen on September 20, 1991, when he went hunting in a region north of Cold Lake in Alberta. His abandoned vehicle was discovered by hunters on a cut line near Cold Lake on either September 21 or 28, 1991. On October 16, 1991, Jack's son reported him missing.

Case reference: 2012020027.CaseDesc: Maggie Lea Burke was last seen on December 9, 2004 in Edmonton, Alberta. She left her residence in the area of 118 avenue and 95 street, to go meet a friend and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2019029100.CaseDesc: Robert Allen Wetsch was reported missing by family on May 19, 2019. There have not been any confirmed sightings of him since.

Case reference: 2018053572.CaseDesc: On February 15, 1996, Maymuna Mohamid was seen for the last time by her brother and sister-in-law in Toronto, Ontario. When her brother returned home, Maymuna and all her personal belongings were gone.

Case reference: 2014004798.CaseDesc: On the 25th of October, 1954, Tersilla Bonthoux, 79 years old, was last seen walking from Duck Lake towards the farm homestead where she used to reside, approximately 13 km away. Tersilla was reported missing and extensive searches of the area failed to locate any trace of her.

Case reference: 2025030773.CaseDesc: John Edwards was last seen at around 16:00 on 11 June 2025, leaving St. Joseph's Villa in Dundas, Ontario. He was walking south on Milgrove Side Road, heading away from Highway 6 in Flamborough. The distance from this location to the villa is approximately 10.3 km. John has cognitive impairments resembling dementia and is considered vulnerable. Due to the unpredictability of his movements and the recent heatwave, the police are extremely concerned for his safety. There is currently no evidence of foul play, and the Hamilton Police Service is appealing to the public and businesses for CCTV and dash cam footage.

Case reference: 2014000003.CaseDesc: Jatinderpal Sandhu was last seen in February 2004 leaving his home in the Northwest area of Toronto.

Jacket: Cotton, Black, waist length; zippered front
Scar: Nose, Small scar on bridge of nose

Case reference: 2014005752.CaseDesc: On the early morning of March 31, 2007, Candace Shpeley was last seen in Chilliwack, British Columbia. There is reason to believe that Ms. Shpeley, a resident of Abbotsford, British Columbia, was travelling from a friend’s residence on the day of her disappearance. Her vehicle, a 1995 green Pontiac Grand Am, was recovered near the Renfrew sky train station in Vancouver, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014005200.CaseDesc: Conrad Hastings was last seen on March 3, 2008 at the bus shelter at Smith Street and Portage Avenue in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  Conrad's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014006317.CaseDesc: Bradden Bushie was last seen on November 16, 2013, when a group home worker dropped him off outside 300 Portage Ave. in Winnipeg, Manitoba, saying he was meeting a female friend at the library. Family and police are concerned for Bradden's well-being.

Shoes: White, Running shoes with black stripes similar to Adidas brand

Case reference: 2014002241.CaseDesc: In April of 1972, Velma Marie Duncan was last seen by her brother hitchhiking from the Gang Ranch area to Williams Lake, BC. Ms. Duncan arrived at her sister’s residence and attended the downtown core of Williams Lake with her sister on May 3rd or 4th, 1972. Ms. Duncan entered a local bar, which was the last time she was seen.

Case reference: 2014001072.CaseDesc: On July 19 1984, the body of a male believed to be between the ages of 18-29 was found in the waters of the Fraser River near Boston Bar, British Columbia. He had some crowding on his upper teeth and no tattoos or obvious scars. It is believed he was deceased for a few months prior to his remains being recovered.

Case reference: 2024001138.CaseDesc: Michael Walker left his friend's home in Norland, Ontario, following a weekend party on November 5, 2023. He was thought to be returning to his father's home, which is located 15 minutes east of the small hamlet of Kinmount, Ontario. On November 6, 2023, Michael's father discovered Michael's vehicle parked in his driveway, open and without keys. Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005520.CaseDesc: On November 20, 2010, at approximately 5:00 p.m., Dina Bat-Og was seen for the last time leaving her home to go to work in Toronto, Ontario. Dina had advised that she would be returning home at midnight, but never returned.

Case reference: 2014004976.CaseDesc: Beric Bason was last seen on July 22, 2007 at Loon Lake Resort near Clinton, British Columbia.  Beric has not been seen or heard from since and the reason for his disappearance is unknown.

Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

She departed from the Continental Inn on May 5, 2025, in the early morning hours.  CCTV footage shows her at a nearby 7-Eleven at 02:55 a.m. Natanis has not been in contact with family since that time, which is highly unusual for her. Her disappearance is considered to be of a suspicious nature.

Case reference: 2014002769.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1983 Michael Weatherly was last seen leaving a taxi at a local General Store in Willow River, British Columbia. Michael was later reported missing by his sibling as the missing's home was found vacant and boarded up. Michael was known to be sick, could not eat solid foods. Michael had returned items he borrowed from others, a week before he went missing.  Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003903.CaseDesc: Anthony Kootenay walked away from the Algar Tower fire camp 73 kilometres south of Fort McMurray, Alberta on July 13, 1985 at approximately 3:00 am. In the previous days he was described by colleagues as suffering from mental health issues related to alcohol abuse. It is believed he may have attempted to hitch-hike from the area as a passing motorist spotted someone matching his description. An extensive search by land and helicopter was conducted, however Anthony was not located. Two unconfirmed sightings occurred at the Grand Hotel in Edmonton, AB on December 23, 1985 and January 16, 1986. There have been no sightings since that time.

Shoes: Blue, Running shoes with no laces
Tattoo: Left Hand, Tony on the 4 fingers
Left Arm, A flower with 4 petals

Case reference: 2014001413.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1959, Captain Charles David Tillsley, Warrant Officer Tyrus Cobb, Sergeant Major James Mackey, and a fourth companion left Fort Churchill on a weekend fishing trip on the Churchill River in Manitoba. They were last seen loading their gear into a boat at the Churchill Dock at around 1 p.m. They were due back on September 20, but failed to return. Fort Churchill's military authorities commenced a search with the aid of helicopters and aircraft. On September 21, the two boats used by the men were located; both were undamaged and swamped. Numerous items belonging to the four men were found. Despite extensive land and water searches, the bodies were not found.

Case reference: 2020008364.CaseDesc: On December 19, 1982, at approximately 10:30 am, Simon Yefronovich was seen for the last time by his friend as he left his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Simon was scheduled to fly to Vancouver, British Columbia, with his friend, but he never boarded the flight.

Case reference: 2022057802.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2022, Kirk Allan Boucher was last seen walking without shoes in the area of the Highway 11 and 71 junction in Manitou Rapids Indian Reserve No. 11 in the Rainy River District, Ontario.

Shoes: Light Blue, Bandaged up, slip on hospital booties

Case reference: 2024042256.CaseDesc: Alexandr "Sasha" Puryga was reported missing on August 13, 2024 after failing to report for work in the vicinity of 7th Concession and 16th Sideroad in Vaughan, Ontario. His vehicle was subsequently located nearby, unoccupied. Given the circumstances, the police and Alexandr's family are concerned for his well-being, and his disappearance is being treated as suspicious.

Case reference: 2014004174.CaseDesc: On October 31, 1979, Larry Warner last made contact with his father and was said to be of no fixed address in Niagara Falls, Ontario. Case reference: 2014002684.CaseDesc: Mathieu Landry was reported missing on February 16, 1994, by a traveling companion, while on vacation in Malaysia. Mathieu's passport, clothing, backpack and other personal effects where recovered from the resort where he was staying and sunglasses belonging to him were found on the beach. Land and water searches involving police divers were done and failed to locate him, Mathieu is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014028357.CaseDesc: On September 1, 2014, Meysam Mokri was seen for the last time leaving his family residence in Port Moody, British Columbia with a duffel bag containing some of his clothing. Meysam has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002147.CaseDesc: On September 22, 1981, the Churchill RCMP received a call from Mrs. Esmoil, who said that her two sons and two friends were late returning from a canoe trip. Numerous items belonging to the men were found on the shore. Three of the four travellers' bodies were recovered in the Churchill River, and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Brian's body has never been found, and it is presumed that he also drowned.

Case reference: 2014001698.CaseDesc: Glenn Fry was last seen at his residence in Delta, British Columbia, on February 14, 2000. Glenn has not been seen or heard from since that time.

Case reference: 2014001837.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1979 at approximately 8:30 a.m. seven men departed from Anama Bay, Manitoba on a fishing trip. The men departed as a group in three separate boats and were heading for Warpath. At approximately 7:30 p.m. that same day, the occupants of the first boat reported to the RCMP that the other two boats were missing. They described the waves as being three to four feet high and they could not see the tree line from where they were. They lost sight of the other two boats and fired shotgun shots into the air hoping for a response. No response was received. Extensive patrols by air, boat and land were made in an attempt to locate the remaining five men. The bodies of Fredrick Ursu and Jerry Hudy were never recovered. They are presumed dead due to drowning.

Case reference: 2006012299.CaseDesc: On June 02, 1984, Andrew Grinnell, his brother, their cousin and a friend departed Sioux Lookout on a canoe trip on the Albany River. The party arrived in Fort Albany on July 18, 1984. At 6:00 p.m. that same day, the party decided to leave Fort Albany in an attempt to paddle to Moosonee via James Bay. The group had planned to go out onto James Bay with the tide and sail to Moosonee by lashing their canoes together. An intense storm engulfed the James Bay coastal area on July 23, 1984, and it is likely that the party perished on the Bay during this storm. Three victims were recovered in August 1984, twelve nautical miles North of the Moose River. Andrew's body has never been recovered.

Case reference: 2014004809.CaseDesc: On August 7, 2006, Jeffrey Peterson was reported missing by a family member. Extensive searches were conducted in the Manitou region and its environs, but Jeffrey was not located.
